title: FGA Character Popup
description: Shows a big floating character portrait on screen when that character speaks in chat, gets bloodied/healed/revived, or has a classified buff/debuff applied — with an optional chat bubble showing the message text (each character's own bubble color and, optionally, its own custom text color, visible the same way to everyone), GM-controlled size/position/flip/fade, and player-chosen portrait vs. token image.

recommends.reason: Not required by v1, but handy if we later need to safely patch core chat behavior.
Not required by v1 (popups are purely client-side), but useful if we later add cross-client sync.
